title: Grateful Dead Live at University of Iowa on 1982-08-10
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Samplitude Professional v10.22 -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Miller‑mastered soundboard captures a smoking 1982 Iowa City show with standout Lost > Saint > Eyes and tight playing throughout.
ai_review.review: The recording is an excellent Miller soundboard tape – crisp, well‑balanced and only a brief first‑set correction. The performance is high‑energy and super‑tight, highlighted by the Lost Sailor > Saint > Eyes sequence, a killer I Need a Miracle > Bertha close, and inspired moments from China/Rider through Iko Iko into Truckin'.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently 5‑star reviews praise both the stellar show and top‑notch soundboard quality; only one outlier low rating does not affect the overall high assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Miller mastering provides crystal‑clear, well‑balanced audio; reviewers note top‑notch sound quality with only a brief first‑set correction and no major dropouts.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: A long, well‑chosen first set ending with I Need a Miracle into Bertha; second set opens strong with China/Rider and builds through Lost/Saint/Eyes, followed by an energetic Iko Iko > Truckin' finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry Garcia's guitar is described as spot‑on and tight all night, with perfect tone.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir delivers an unusual and inspired performance, especially on Iko Iko.
